name: inventor-ilogic
description: How Autodesk Inventor iLogic rules behave when code changes a document: triggers, cost, rule text, and the Security Alert.

interface.longDescription: How Autodesk Inventor iLogic rules behave when code changes a document through the API: parameter change triggers and their cost, turning rules off for a batch, reading and changing rule text, running a rule, rule error dialogs, and the iLogic Security Alert.
defaultPrompt: How do I change many Inventor parameters without running the iLogic rules each time?
